title: SO(5) deconfined multicriticality: mixed-correlator bootstrap and fuzzy-sphere data
description: Spectra, OPE coefficients, extremal-functional matrices and raw inputs for the SO(5) mixed vector-singlet-tensor conformal bootstrap at derivative order 23 and the SO(5) fuzzy-sphere model up to N=12 orbitals, including primary identifications from special conformal generators and conversion factors to a common OPE convention. Data files are licensed under CC BY 4.0; code (the Mathematica notebook) under MIT. See README.md and DATA_GUIDE.md.
